CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_driver_age(p_drv_main INTEGER)
RETURNS INTEGER AS $$
    SELECT CASE WHEN d.driver_identity->>'birth_date' IS NOT NULL 
         THEN FLOOR((CURRENT_DATE - (d.driver_identity->>'birth_date')::DATE) / 365.25)::INTEGER
         ELSE NULL END
    FROM drivers d
    WHERE d.drv_main = p_drv_main;
$$ LANGUAGE SQL;
